identity.title: 2b-RAD: a simple and flexible method for genome-wide genotyping.

documents.rationale: Readable five-page original article hosted by coauthor McKay's institutional laboratory. Title, authors and DOI match the unchanged assignment; Online Methods are included. Page 4 describes the BsaXI/Illumina implementation with first amplification per sample and subsequent barcode PCR. It identifies the Supplementary Protocol and Supplementary Table 10 as relevant attachments but does not establish the requested cross-sample pooling interface.

documents.rationale: Second readable author-hosted copy of the exact original five-page article, reached through its citation on the Matz laboratory publications page. Includes the Online Methods and the pointer to an optimized Supplementary Protocol. This is an alternative acquisition source for the assigned paper, not a different implementation.

Actual original Protocol Exchange source URL observed through the reproduction's source link; opening it failed with Cache miss, so readable original content is unverified. The reproduction attributes this separately published protocol to Wang, Meyer, McKay and Matz, dated 6 June 2012, and describes AlfI/SOLiD preparation with barcode incorporation during PCR and pooling after purification. No verified citation from the assigned article to this separate DOI was recovered; it is therefore a related source lead, not a registered cited dependency or the recovered original supplement.

Readable institutional copy of an author protocol by Galina Aglyamova and Mikhail Matz, updated 25 August 2014. Its overview explicitly identifies itself as a modification of DOI 10.1038/nmeth.2023 for Illumina HiSeq using BcgI, with AlfI as an alternative. It states that ligated 3-prime adapter barcodes preserve sample identity when twelve ligations are pooled before amplification. This directly documents that interface for the later implementation, but its two-base-overhang chemistry does not establish the catalogue's BsaXI/NNN route and cannot replace the assigned 2012 evidence.

Publicly indexed manufacturer catalogue page citing the assigned Wang et al. paper. Its description places cross-sample combination after BsaXI/NNN adapter ligation and before amplification, but supplies no earlier sample-identity carrier. This preserves the catalogue side of the discrepancy; it is not a detailed manufacturer protocol resolving that discrepancy.

searches.query: Adjudicate recovered sources against construction, record, scope:2b-RAD and unknown:pooling_interface requests
searches.note: No verified source recovered that establishes both pre-amplification cross-sample combination and its identity carrier for the catalogue's BsaXI/NNN implementation. The existing assigned paper supports per-sample first PCR followed by barcode PCR. The separately published 2012 protocol transcription describes an optimized AlfI/SOLiD route with pooling after purification. The 2014 author modification explicitly supports pre-PCR pooling through ligated 3-prime barcodes for BcgI/AlfI. The original combined supplement is identified but its actual download URL and content remain unresolved. These implementation differences require human adjudication; no pooling edge or graph acceptance is asserted.
